I used to use Telegram but heard many cryptographers suggesting that it was insecure. Their arguments were that Telegram programs used their own encryption protocol which had serious security flaws. These flaws seem to be addressed, but there still has been significant criticism towards the entire project. It looks like a well done app, but the security is what worries me.

The current favored alternative is Textsecure(Android) and Signal (iOS) by Open Whisper Systems. There have been several audits by professional cryptographers who have stated that there are some security flaws(every piece of software has that) but there was nothing that was serious.
